name: io.github.abangdwie/ip-geolocation
description: IPv4 geolocation: country, city, ASN via DB-IP Lite. $0.001/call USDC on Base via x402.

tools.name: ip_lookup
tools.description: Look up one IPv4 address: country code + name, continent, region/state, city, latitude/longitude, ASN number + organization name, from the DB-IP Lite database (CC BY 4.0, November 2026 edition). IPv6 is not supported in v1. Timezone is not available in DB-IP Lite and is not included. Costs $0.001 USDC per call, paid via x402 on Base.

ip.description: IPv4 address to look up, e.g. 8.8.8.8

tools.name: ip_self
tools.description: Geolocation of the caller's own IP from Cloudflare edge data (country, city, region, ASN, timezone when available). Free, no payment required.

tools.name: health
tools.description: Check that the server is alive. Free, no payment required.

tools.name: catalog
tools.description: List all tools with their prices in USDC. Free, no payment required.
